text: The Search page now explains what you can do there: recommend, save, or see what friends thought.
A Sunday email with up to three picks from people you follow.
A tidier Me page, with your invites split into Pending and Joined.
A new loading screen starring Rex and his remote.
Pull down to refresh in the Home Screen app.
Invite links now open a page that explains TV Rex to newcomers.
See which invites are pending or joined, and remove links you don't need.
My list now has Watching, Want to watch and Watched.
Search shows which friends have reviewed a show, and you can filter by genre.
See who joined from your invites, and every rating on a profile, misses included.
Send feedback from the bottom of the Feed or Me.
A brighter blue look and larger text, to match Wiki Walk.
Add a profile photo, and the feed opens faster.
New here? Request an invite from the sign-in screen.
New name: TV Rex, with a new dinosaur icon.
A Help page, and text that follows your iPhone's text size.
Follow people, and switch your feed between Everyone and Following.
